sections.section_content:
Figure443 shows the functional blocks in the display subsystem, with their instance/design
names:
• LTDC: composition engine, includes a parallel interface
• Parallel GPIO: Parallel I/O-ring of the device with up to 24bpp + H/V synchronization
• RIMU/RISAD: RIF security logic, configured for the specific display needs
